scope: New transfer of the three frozen beta=3.05 03 final stock encoders (6101,6102,6103; update 10218) and TRAIN scalar coefficients. No target fitting, local children, new trajectories, Modal, or GPU. Compare the already exposed 03 source TEST baseline and independent nonlocal parents at 3.20 and 3.40. No temperature-specific refitting, label alignment, or selection of a winning seed.
lineage: Select only plan.json, sole prep batch head and named native snapshots at ages 300M,500M. Verify each immutable digest, named beta/IDs, parent IDs, low two bits, all species counts and neighbor masks plus Hamiltonian energy of each endpoint. Source release uses axes chain,z,y,x in C order; keep same axis order, states and arm ordering with NO alignment. Deduplicate by campaign seed & parent id, reject conflicts and require 128 distinct per beta and identical identity sets across ages, disjoint from source. Source comparison uses original eligible 8187/8192 03 held rows.
anchors: 03 PCG64([309031,b,seed,chain_id]); use new stable beta indices b=10 (3.20),11 (3.40). Same shift and permutation at both ages. 216 disjoint periodic seven-site stars on 3-spaced grid, first candidate of inventory 223, otherwise missing; include explicit exclusions. Secondary: all eligible disjoint candidate stars per snapshot, equal parent weight (mean sufficient moments within each eligible parent, not a mixture of its different conditional Gibbs laws). Same code and nulls; no independent-anchors error bars. Report whether the selected anchor changed in age-complete pairs.
scores: For each seed report source scalar T=variance of the boundary mean / total variance, within and total variance; compare fixed center vacancy and 3.05 TRAIN site-linear. Hard label normalized agreement A=(mean||q||^2-||mean q||^2)/(1-||mean q||^2). Specificity D=A-mean of 64 normalized fixed null agreements. Exactly 05 PCG64([509005,2,2,3,seed]) permutations of the 210-state frozen labels, shared over temperatures/ages; preserve unweighted counts, not Gibbs entropy. Report null marginal entropies, coincidence and same-minus-independent baselines. Whole-state collision, empirical center and labels vs predicted mass, marginal H and mean conditional H and I(B;H) in bits. Q from exact Hamiltonian and target beta with B frozen, NOT observed real-time replica trajectories. Secondary 07: frozen cold prior/packing/directional and preassigned rotated control; expected bits and directional-mode success with no calibration on targets.
decision: (i) Strong retained static transfer at each primary target if all three lower pointwise 95% bounds on frozen scalar T >.90 with identifiable total variance (>1e-10) and at least 10 effective total-variance parents. This is not an improvement over packing. (ii) each seed's D at each 500M target, (iii) D(3.40)-D(3.20): per-seed practical margin +.01; lower>.01 supports, upper<.01 excludes the margin at empirical-bootstrap resolution, else unresolved. All three required for joint positive. If categorical denominator <.05 or residual-pin-deficit ESS<10 for learned or mean-null in either contributing target, flag rarity: no population-level positive or exclusion for that comparison. Descriptive sample values remain. Saturation is not a privileged partition. Intervals pointwise across parents conditional on source fits and fixed null bank, not across seeds/nulls.
uncertainty: 4096 percentile bootstrap draws per target, resample existing chain IDs intact, independent streams by beta; same draws across seeds, nulls, sensitivities and both ages. Exclude ineligible parents from a given level. For 500M-300M use intersection eligible both ages, resample those complete parent pairs jointly, only age changes not new parents. Source 2048 parent draws, plus 1024 random source subsets of 128 without replacement for finite-n sensitivity. Report target entropy plugin vs leave-one-parent-out jackknife bias-corrected I; paired age/temperature intervals, counts, deficit ESS, possible missed rare events and limitations of small-n bootstrap. Full source replay of frozen 03/05/07 scores on original TEST, not a new independent test.
ages: 300M strictly paired sensitivity, no pooling. Include mean native energy/site at both ages and its paired change with parent uncertainty as an age diagnostic, not an equilibration certificate. No source 300M snapshot is inferred.
